sloka: एकम् एक अयने कृच्छ्रे निःश्वसन्तम् मुहुर् मुहुः ।समीक्ष्य दुःखितो रामः सौमित्रिम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६७-२३॥
transliteration: ekam eka ayane kṛcchre niḥśvasantam muhur muhuḥ ।samīkṣya duḥkhito rāmaḥ saumitrim idam abravīt ॥3-67-23॥

translations.english: Rama saw Jatayu breathing with difficulty in that solitary, inaccessible place.Overcome by greater grief he said to Lakshmana:
